note: Conditions check what the customer said. Inside the loop, use If Tea IN Orders to test it, then Write Tea or Write Coffee.
solution:
POSITION listen
LISTEN
TAKE UP
IF tea IN CUSTOMER SPEECH
  ITEM tea
ELSE
  ITEM coffee
END
MOVE RIGHT 1
DEPOSIT RIGHT
MOVE LEFT 1
JUMP listen
